class GauthTapper {
  public debug_logs = false;

  private device_id: string = "1234567890123456789";
  private aid = "369768";
  private device_platform = "web";
  private sub_platform = "web";
  private _region = "tw";
  private app_region = "tw";
  private app_name = "ehi_overseas";
  private language = "en";
  private msToken = "rNSPnlC6Rj3comOJ8QcHX48YFfoj2MAZj7PgX5xCIGu91wKKBQ23zqWtn6hxOXx6Zx7pcO5D-i5E_7EaxWK6GizZcqTXhfmo5_tDJZcHbtoqWoU2_HV2WA9MwUbBaXsfCw8bT-pq1LFh";
  private a_bogus = "OX4Vh7UjYpmVapMGucNVt6oRvHIANs8yNli%2FSTiHCNw4GqePlDe9qpcPnxwD0W67J8k4OCIHJVTMYnxcQyis1I9kKmkvuzwy3mxVVw8o0qZfbPkZvrmECbSEqJPzlCTTYAIViZyRXs0e2x5WVr9TABcHu%2FUxR5jdPN-UV%2FznE9uRB%2F8nwx1fTcyQTDpukTMVFTiMynsSXwL%3D";

  constructor() {
    this.randomize_device_id();
  }

  private randomize_device_id() {
    const digits = Array.from({ length: 19 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 10));
    this.device_id = digits.join('');
  }

  private get_url_parameters(return_as_search_params_object = true) {
    const url_parameters = {
      device_id: this.device_id,
      aid: this.aid,
      device_platform: this.device_platform,
      sub_platform: this.sub_platform,
      _region: this._region,
      app_region: this.app_region,
      app_name: this.app_name,
      language: this.language,
      msToken: this.msToken,
      a_bogus: this.a_bogus,
    }
    if (return_as_search_params_object) {
      return new URLSearchParams(url_parameters)
    }
    return url_parameters
  }

  private async upload_image(image: Base64URLString | Blob | File): Promise<string> {
    const url_parameters = this.get_url_parameters()
    let request_url = `https://api-sea.gauthmath.com/ehi/web_api/material/upload?${url_parameters}`

    const form_data = new FormData();
    let image_file: File | null = null;

    if (typeof image == "string") {
      const fetch_response = await fetch(image)
      const image_blob = await fetch_response.blob()
      image_file = new File([image_blob], "image.jpg", {
        type: image_blob.type,
      })
    }
    else if (image instanceof File) {
      image_file = image
    }
    else if (image instanceof Blob) {
      image_file = new File([image], "image.jpg", {
        type: image.type,
      })
    }
    
    if (image_file) {
      form_data.append("file", image_file);
  
      const response = await fetch(request_url, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "accept": "*/*",
          "accept-language": "en-US,en;q=0.9",
          "agw-js-conv": "str",
        },
        referrer: "https://www.gauthmath.com/",
        body: form_data,
      });
    
      const data = JSON.parse(await response.text())
      if (this.debug_logs) console.log(data)

      return data.Uri as string;
    }
    console.log("Upload Image Error!")
    return "1"
  }
}

export async function gauth_request_upload() {
  const url_parameters = new URLSearchParams({
      device_id: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.device_id,
      aid: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.aid,
      device_platform: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.device_platform,
      sub_platform: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.sub_platform,
      _region: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS._region,
      app_region: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.app_region,
      app_name: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.app_name,
      language: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.language,
      msToken: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.msToken,
      a_bogus: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.a_bogus,
  })
  let request_url = `https://api-sea.gauthmath.com/ehi/web_api/material/upload?${url_parameters}`

  const form_data = new FormData();
  const QUESTION_BASE64 = "data:image/png;base64,"
  
  const r = await fetch(QUESTION_BASE64);
  const image_blob = await r.blob();
  const image_file = new File([image_blob], "image.jpg", {
      type: image_blob.type,
  });
  
  form_data.append("file", image_file);

  const response = await fetch(request_url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "accept": "*/*",
      "accept-language": "en-US,en;q=0.9",
      "agw-js-conv": "str",
    },
    referrer: "https://www.gauthmath.com/",
    body: form_data,
  });

  const data = await response.text();
  return data;
}

export async function gauth_request_create_v2(gauth_uri: string) {
    const url_parameters = new URLSearchParams({
        device_id: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.device_id,
        aid: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.aid,
        device_platform: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.device_platform,
        sub_platform: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.sub_platform,
        _region: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS._region,
        app_region: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.app_region,
        app_name: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.app_name,
        language: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.language,
        msToken: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.msToken,
        a_bogus: URL_PARAMETER_CONTSTANTS.a_bogus,
    })
    let request_url = `https://api-sea.gauthmath.com/ehi/question/create_v2?${url_parameters}`

    const response = await fetch(request_url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "accept": "*/*",
        "accept-language": "en-US,en;q=0.9",
        "agw-js-conv": "str",
      },
      referrer: "https://www.gauthmath.com/",
      body: JSON.stringify({
        image: {
            uri: gauth_uri,
            width: 730,
            height: 646,
        },
        region: "tw",
      }),
    });
  
    const data = await response.text();
    return data;
}
